intro: These terms govern your use of Cluega and the AI models available through it. Please read the AI usage warnings carefully — you remain responsible for every prompt you submit and every output you publish.

banner.title: Violations can get your account banned
banner.body: Requests that break these rules may be blocked before they run or fail mid-job. Repeated or severe violations — especially anything involving minors — lead to suspension or permanent termination, and are reported to the authorities where the law requires it.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.body: By creating a project, submitting a prompt, or generating any image, video, audio or text on Cluega, you accept these terms and the policies referenced below.
bullets: You must have the legal capacity to enter into a contract in your jurisdiction, and you must meet the minimum age for digital consent that applies where you live.
If you use Cluega on behalf of a company or client, you confirm you are authorised to accept these terms for them.
We may update these terms as features, models and applicable law change. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.

aiUsage.title: 2. Using AI models — what you must know
aiUsage.body: Cluega routes your requests to third-party AI models. Output is generated statistically, not verified. Treat it as a draft, never as fact.
bullets: Output can be wrong, outdated, biased, or entirely fabricated — including names, statistics, quotes, prices and product claims. Verify anything factual before you publish it.
The same prompt can produce different results on different runs. Nothing about output is guaranteed to be unique, reproducible, or free of resemblance to existing work.
You are responsible for reviewing, editing and approving output before it reaches customers, an ad platform, or the public.
Where the law requires it, disclose that content was generated or assisted by AI.
Model availability, quality, speed and pricing depend on upstream providers and can change or fail without notice.
Do not rely on AI output for decisions with legal, medical, safety or financial consequences without a qualified human review.

prohibited.title: 3. Prohibited use and abuse
prohibited.body: The following uses are forbidden. Requests may be refused or fail, and repeated attempts can lead to suspension or termination.
bullets: Fraud, scams, phishing, fake giveaways, fake reviews or testimonials, and any deceptive advertising.
Impersonating a real person, brand or public authority, and creating deepfakes or voice clones of identifiable people without their documented consent.
Sexual content, harassment, hate speech, slurs, incitement to violence, or content targeting a person or protected group.
Self-harm, suicide, eating-disorder, weapons or drug-manufacturing instructions.
Malware, exploits, credential-stealing pages, spam infrastructure, or content designed to evade platform moderation.
Attempts to bypass safety controls: jailbreak prompts, prompt injection, system-prompt extraction, or data exfiltration from tools and connected sources.
Automated scraping of the service, load-testing without permission, sharing API keys, or reselling model access as your own service.
Uploading personal data of others without a lawful basis, and uploading confidential material you are not permitted to process.

financial.title: 4. Financial content — no advice
financial.body: Cluega is a creative and marketing tool, not a financial adviser. Nothing produced through it is investment, tax, accounting or legal advice.
bullets: Do not use output as a basis for investment, trading, lending, insurance or tax decisions.
Do not generate content promising returns, guaranteed profits, "risk-free" earnings, or trading signals, and do not present AI output as a professional recommendation.

Financial, crypto, lending, gambling and insurance promotions are heavily regulated in most countries. If you advertise in these categories, complying with disclosure, licensing and ad-platform rules is entirely your responsibility.
Any price, cost or performance figure that appears in generated copy must be independently verified before publication.

minors.title: 5. Children and minors — zero tolerance
minors.body: There is no exception, no artistic exemption and no test case for content that sexualises or endangers a minor.
bullets: Any attempt to generate, upload, describe or request sexual, nude, suggestive or exploitative content involving a minor is strictly forbidden.
Such activity results in immediate termination of the account, and we will preserve and report the relevant records to the competent authorities where the law requires it.
Do not upload photographs of children as reference material for generation.
Cluega is not directed at children. Do not let a child use your account, and do not create an account for anyone below the minimum age of digital consent in your country.
Advertising aimed at children must comply with the additional protections that apply in your market.

adultContent.title: 6. Adult and 18+ content
adultContent.body: Cluega is not an adult-content platform. Explicit generation is out of scope for this service.
bullets: Pornographic, sexually explicit and gratuitously violent or gory generation is not permitted, including through euphemism, coded wording or reference images.
Upstream model providers run their own moderation. A request they classify as unsafe will be rejected and the job will fail — this is outside our control and is not a service fault.
Repeated attempts to produce prohibited material are treated as abuse and may lead to rate limiting, suspension or termination.
Age-restricted products (alcohol, tobacco, gambling, adult goods) may only be advertised where local law and the destination ad platform allow it, with the required audience targeting.

ipRights.title: 7. Intellectual property and uploaded material
ipRights.body: You are responsible for the rights in everything you put into Cluega and everything you take out of it.
bullets: Only upload images, video, audio, fonts or text that you own or are licensed to use.
Do not use third-party trademarks, logos, characters or a person's likeness without permission. Some models refuse branded material outright.
Copyright in AI-generated output is unsettled and varies by country — in several jurisdictions purely generated material may not be protectable at all.
Third-party model and provider terms apply on top of these terms, including any restriction on commercial use of a specific model's output.

enforcement.title: 8. Enforcement, blocking and availability
enforcement.body: We operate content and safety controls across the routing layer and the media pipeline, and providers apply their own on top.
bullets: A request may be refused before it runs, or fail mid-job, when it is flagged by our safety policy or by a provider's moderation system.
Safety controls are not perfect in either direction: prohibited material can slip through, and legitimate requests are sometimes blocked by mistake. Neither outcome changes what these terms permit.
We may rate limit, suspend or terminate access for policy violations, abusive load, non-payment or suspected fraud.
The service is provided on an "as is" basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, specific model uptime, or fitness for a particular purpose.
Report abuse or a policy concern to us using the contact below.

dataPrivacy.title: 9. Data and privacy
dataPrivacy.body: What we keep is limited to what is needed to run, bill and secure the service.
bullets: Prompt and response bodies are not retained in our usage and spend logs — content retention is disabled at the routing layer.
We do record request metadata: timestamp, model, token counts, cost, tenant and user identifiers, and error status. This is used for billing, quotas, abuse prevention and troubleshooting.
Assets you upload and files generated for you are stored in Cluega storage so you can reopen your projects, and are deleted with the project.
Your prompts are transmitted to the third-party model provider that serves the request; their own processing and retention terms then apply.
Do not submit payment card details, passwords, health records or government identity numbers in a prompt.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms, takedown requests and abuse reports can be sent to our support team, who will route them to the responsible owner.
bullets: Support and policy questions: support@cluega.com
Abuse, safety and child-safety reports: abuse@cluega.com
Include the project name, the approximate time, and the model used so we can locate the request.
